Justice Gautam Kumar Choudhary

For the State : Ms. Nehala Sharmin, Special P.P.

For the O.P. No.2 : Mr. D.K. Malityar, Advocate
------
Order No.09 Dated : 04.10.2024
1.

The instant criminal miscellaneous petition has been filed for cancellation of anticipatory bail
granted to the opposite party no.2 vide order dated 10.08.2022 passed in A.B.A. No.3030 of 2022
(arising out of Chanho P.S. Case No.228 of 2020 registered under Sections 376, 313, 323, 325, 498A,
506, 511/34 of the Indian Penal Code).

2.  It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner/victim that earlier the opposite party no.2 had committed rape with the victim/girl on a false promise of marriage and later on, when he did not abide by the promise, a Panchayti was convened on 29.09.2016 in which he agreed to marry her and the marriage was solemnized on 29.09.2016.
It is alleged that her pregnancy was terminated by administering medicine to her.

Thereafter, a case was lodged and the matter was referred to the Mediation Centre, JHALSA, Ranchi, wherein the matter was amicably settled between the parties vide terms of the compromise dated 26.07.2022 and considering the said settlement, the anticipatory bail application of the petitioner was allowed.
3. It is submitted that the opposite party no.2 had no intention to abide by the terms of the settlement and settlement was only a ruse to get the bail.
Not a single terms and condition of settlement has been honoured by the opposite party no.2.

sentences.text: I find force in the argument advanced on behalf of petitioner that OP No.2 had no intention to honour the terms of compromise and the compromise was entered only to get anticipatory bail by this Court.

In this manner, opposite party no.2 has played not only fraud with the petitioner by committing rape on false promise of marriage, but also has played fraud with this Court by entering into a false settlement and getting a bail on its basis.
5.
This is a case of fraud and it will unravel everything.

In the present case, adjournment after adjournment was sought on the pretext that the settlement will be honoured between the parties in mediation during pendency of anticipatory bail application will be honoured.
It is not the province of this Court to force the parties into a settlement.
However, when the parties by their own consent entered into a settlement which became the foundation of passing an order, the sanctity of the said settlement needs to be preserved.
Otherwise the submissions, settlement before the Court of Law will lose all sanctity and force.

Under the aforesaid facts and circumstance, anticipatory bail earlier granted by this Court in A.B.A.
No.3030 of 2022 is cancelled and the learned trial Court is directed to proceed as per law against the opposite party no.2 to secure his appearance before the Court.
Criminal Miscellaneous Petition is allowed.

(Gautam Kumar Choudhary, J.) Anit Seema Lakra Aged About 24 Years Wife Of ... vs The State Of Jharkhand on 4 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75800649/
